FIELDS.GL CODE: NO GL CODE AVAILABLE DUE TO RESTRICTIONS ON ONLINE SALES.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Petal & Bloom Floral Supplies, we specialize in retailing high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations primarily focus on offering a diverse selection of floral products, including arrangements, decorative accents, and essential tools for crafting beautiful displays. We maintain a physical storefront where customers can directly explore our offerings, ensuring that online sales do not exceed 50% of our total revenue, thereby keeping our primary risk exposure within a controlled environment. Our inventory is securely stored in a climate-controlled space to protect against spoilage and degradation, and our processes are designed to comply with local zoning and fire regulations. Additionally, we prioritize employee training to maintain safety and operational standards, thereby enhancing both workplace safety and customer satisfaction.

Our business specializes in creating and selling artificial flowers and floral supplies, with a significant portion of our revenue coming from our online sales platform, where we connect with customers nationwide to offer our products.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Online floral supply store operating as "Petal & Bloom Boutique".
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Online sales generated approximately $800 in revenue from February 1, 2023, to February 15, 2023, due to limited inventory, leading to a loss of potential sales; current status is monitored for compliance with the 50% sales limit.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: "Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: Closed"
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured storage with climate control and 24/7 monitored surveillance.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Petal & Bloom Floral Supplies does not have any catastrophe exposure, as we maintain a physical storefront and comply with all necessary safety regulations to mitigate risks associated with our operations.
